text:
emily: evening handoff — I'm signing off in ~25m. Quick notes below, nothing critical but a few things to watch and a couple of small asks. :wave:

emily: highlights
- Canary deployment to eu-west (model-serving v2.3) finished at 19:05 PT, traffic at 5% (see deploy-bot confirmation).
- Noticed a small uptick in cache eviction rate on cache-prod-1 after the new batching change; overall latency stable but hit brief spikes around 18:40.
- Prefetch job (daily-hot-keys) ran long at 03:10 UTC and bumped mem usage on node pool b. Maria will look tomorrow AM.

deploy-bot: deploy eu-canary/model-serving:v2.3 succeeded — 2026-03-18T19:05:12Z

raj: saw the eviction spikes too. hypothesis: continuous-batching change increased effective memory per request. Lowering `max_batch_size` from 64 -> 48 reduced evictions in my local canary.

leo: thanks, raj. can you open a tiny config PR with that change? prefer a canary tweak first. pinging @leo for review on the PR once it's up. :mag:

raj: will do. PR target branch `canary-eu-2026-03-18`. small diff: `max_batch_size: 48` and add a comment about memory implications.

maria: I'll follow up on prefetch job timings tomorrow at 09:30 PT. if anyone sees repeat long runs overnight, slack me and i'll bump job priority or split the keyset.

oncall-bot: reminder — disk usage on cache-prod-1 at 68%, cache-prod-2 at 71% (threshold 80%). No alert triggered.

emily: action items before I go:
- raj: open canary PR and set to 5% traffic (rollout policy) — aim to merge within the hour if green.
- leo: quick review on PR, check eviction curve in dashboards (metrics -> cache.evictions per minute).
- maria: inspection of prefetch timing tomorrow AM, consider splitting hot-key set.

emily: small helpful commands if you need to check the canary quickly:
```bash
# check canary pods
kubectl get pods -n model-eu -l app=model-serving-canary
# tail logs for canary
kubectl logs -n model-eu deploy/model-serving-canary -f --since=5m
```

leo: noted. I'll take the PR once raj posts it. also leaving a note to watch for any user-facing increase in 95th pct latency — i'll set a short Grafana alert for next 6 hours.

raj: PR posted: https://git.redwood/model-serving/pull/1147 — change + comment. set traffic to 5% in rollout config.

leo: reviewing now. :eyes:

emily: thanks team — leaving the pager with @leo (you ok with that?)

leo: yep I'm on for the next 3 hours. ping me directly if anything spikes.

emily: one FYI: I toggled `debug_token_tracing` off in eu-canary to reduce log noise. if you need it on for repro, re-enable with the key below and set a TTL

```yaml
# toggle (do not leave on for >1h in prod)
debug_token_tracing: false
debug_ttl_minutes: 60
```

maria: thanks — will watch the prefetch job and disk usage in morning.

oncall-bot: shift assignment update — current primary: leo, secondary: maria.

emily: that's it from me. enjoy the evening :coffee:
